text:
olivia_sales: Passing Pulseleaf (MidMarket, ~$85k ARR) to CS for activation. PO signed; target go-live 2026-04-07. Main blockers: SAML SSO not live and a custom embeddings API connector still outstanding. They want hosted first. Kate (kate@pulseleaf.com) is Okta admin.

olivia_sales: Quick detail: Okta will supply attributes email, firstName, lastName. They'll need user invites asap once SSO is green.

rahul_cs: I'll lead onboarding. @devon_support can you own the SSO metadata exchange and initial test? @sasha_eng please look at the connector scope and map required fields. I'll schedule a 30m kickoff Thu 3pm PT.

devon_support: Will open an INF ticket and request IdP metadata and cert. Do we have SP metadata or should I ask Kate?

olivia_sales: Sending SP metadata link now: https://okta.pulseleaf.com/admin/app/12345/sso/saml/metadata. They expect matching on `email`.

sasha_eng: Confirming hosted-first. For the connector: seems like we'll need a mapping for embeddings payload + an auth header. Estimate 2 business days for triage and PR; if CORS proxy required add 1 day. Also note they asked about 200ms p95 for generation.

rahul_cs: Action owners: Devon 1 INF- to request metadata and run SAML test. Sasha 1 review connector + post mapping ETA. Rahul 1 schedule kickoff and create Gainsight record pulseleaf-onboard-2026 to track feature asks and docs gaps. Olivia 1 keep contract contact available. Renewal ~11 months out, set to Medium risk until usage begins.

devon_support: INF-4720 created and pinged kate@pulseleaf.com for metadata/cert. Will attempt first assertion test within 24h of receiving metadata.

sasha_eng: Noted. I'll post mapping notes and any header passthrough requirements by EOD +2bd. If hosted path needs egress allowlist, call that out.

rahul_cs: Applied template midmarket_sso_v1 to the runbook and added compliance checkbox for 365d transcript retention. Kickoff invite sent.

olivia_sales: Customer expects invites within 2w of SSO green. I'm available for any PO/contract clarifications. :thumbsup:

enablement_bot: Template applied and a follow-up task set to 3 business days.
